one_month_reasoning: No company earnings in the window: fiscal Q1 FY27 results are confirmed for 2026-11-05 after the close (Earnings Whispers), i.e. after the 2026-11-01 horizon (a Sunday, so effectively the 2026-10-30 close). Events inside the window are hyperscaler Q3 earnings/capex commentary in the last week of October (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) which move the optics complex as a group, plus pre-earnings positioning. The stock has just run from ~$908 (Sep 28 close, after a sector selloff on glass-substrate fears) to $1085 (+~20% in four sessions) to a new high; short-horizon reversal after such a sharp move roughly offsets momentum and capex-season tailwinds. I therefore stay near-neutral: median ~$1080 (slightly below spot), monthly sigma ~0.25 (between annual vol/3.5 = 0.28 and a somewhat lower forward vol), giving P(>=spot) ~0.49.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (FY28 EPS ~$28 x 35x = $980, weight 0.6) and EV/NTM sales at the horizon (~$8.4B x 12x + ~$1.1B net cash over ~104M shares = $982, weight 0.4). Fair value ~$980, about 10% below the $1085 close.

bear.story: AI optics cycle digestion: hyperscaler 2027 capex growth disappoints vs the ~50% expected, InP capacity added across the industry closes the 30%+ EML gap, pricing turns, and the market treats FY28 EPS of ~$20-22 as peak earnings at ~22x. Insider selling (69 sales, 0 buys) and fund exits already show holders taking profits.

base.story: Execution continues: OCS >$100M/qtr, 1.6T and 200G EML ramp, CPO UHP laser shipments start 2H CY27; FY28 EPS tracks ~$28-30 and the multiple compresses from ~39x to ~35-37x, leaving the stock roughly flat after a very volatile path.

bull.story: Scale-up CPO and external light source orders broaden beyond the lead customer, $2B quarter is hit early and margins exceed 45% op; FY28/FY29 EPS heads toward $35-40 and the market keeps a 45-50x multiple on scarcity of InP light sources.

thesis_break_reason: Around $600 the stock would trade near 21x consensus FY28 EPS ($26.40), a multiple consistent only with the market concluding earnings are at a cyclical peak: e.g. order push-outs from the lead GPU customer, hyperscaler capex cuts for 2027, a CPO architecture shift away from Lumentum lasers, or a guide-down on the Nov-5 or Feb print. A ~45% drawdown is larger than one realized-vol sigma (~0.7-1.0) would explain from noise alone given the strong reported trajectory.

reasoning: Facts: Q4 FY26 revenue $1.01B (+109% y/y), non-GAAP GM 50.4%, op margin 36.6%, EPS $3.23; Q1 FY27 guide $1.225-1.275B, EPS $4.05-4.35, ~102M diluted shares; cash $2.74B vs $1.6B current converts [1,2]. Alternative-lane evidence is uniformly bullish on fundamentals but shows positioning risk: independent Substacks (photoncap, FundaAI) document a 30%+ EML supply gap, NVIDIA locking up a large share of InP output, multi-hundred-million CPO POs for 1H27 and a ~$2B/quarter revenue goal [3,4,5]; Quiver data show 69 insider sales and zero buys over six months plus large fund exits, and a well-known AI-focused fund exited its position per 13F [7,12]; trading data show the stock went ~$1000 (May) -> ~$875 (June) -> ~$908 (Sep 28) -> $1085 (Oct 2), so it is only ~+8% since May despite two strong prints - i.e. the multiple is already compressing as earnings rise [3,8,9,13]. Valuation: at $1085 the stock is ~39x my FY28 EPS of ~$28 (consensus $26.40 [10]); I blend P/E (35x) and EV/sales (12x NTM) to a fair value ~$980. Base rate: realized vol 97%; I use ~0.68 forward sigma for the 12-month lognormal, centered at ~$1050 (between fair value and spot, giving some credit to earnings momentum), which reproduces my scenario mix (25% bear ~$480, 50% base ~$1080, 25% bull ~$1850; mean ~$1125). Ladder thus puts P(>=spot) ~0.48, fat tails both ways (8% above $2714, ~10% below $434).
